case_title.correct_value: Kattukulangara Madhavan (Dead) thr. LRs v. Majeed & Ors.
case_title.quote: A KATTUKULANGARA MADHAVAN (DEAD) THR. LRS. v. MAJEED & ORS.
case_title.reason: Title is right, but the leading 'A' is a page-margin marker, not part of the name.

number_of_accused.reason: Accused decided by the Court (A3-A11, A13-A18) total 15.

accused_gender.reason: Accused A4 is referred to with 'his' throughout, supporting Male.

accused_age.reason: No age of any accused is stated.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is described.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No wealth or class statement about the accused appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Suresh Babu is referred to as male with 'he' and 'his'.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Political rivalry between opposed parties is described, with no personal link.

offence_category.reason: The case is tried as murder under s.302 r/w s.149.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charged sections match para 4; final s.326/149 matches the Court's order.

weapon.reason: Knife MO.1 and sticks/reaper are both described in the evidence.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness testimony and medical evidence are the main evidence relied on.

confession.reason: No confession or admission is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Stab wound death and political motive are noted facts.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Lapse of time and simple non-vital injuries by sticks are noted.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted A1, A2, A3, A4, A14, A15, A18 under s.302 r/w s.149 IPC, life imprisonment; acquitted A5-A13, A16, A17
trial_court_outcome.quote: The Sessions Court, Thrissur convicted A1 to A4, A14, A15 and A18 under Section 302 read with 149
trial_court_outcome.reason: Value omits A3, who was also convicted by the trial court.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Acquitted A3, A14, A15, A18 of s.302/149; A2 and A4 convicted under s.324/149 (1 year); A1's s.302 conviction upheld; acquittal of A5-A13, A16, A17 upheld
high_court_outcome.quote: A2 and A4 were convicted under Section 324/149 IPC and were sentenced to imprisonment of 1 year.
high_court_outcome.reason: Value omits that A2's conviction was altered to s.324/149 and that A1's s.302 conviction was upheld.

final_outcome.reason: Convictions for five accused were modified to s.326/149; others remained acquitted.

offence_finally_established.quote: their conviction under Section 326/149 IPC will meet the ends of justice
offence_finally_established.reason: Section is right, but the label 'grievous hurt' is not used in the judgment.

imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence is a fixed term of 7 years.

imprisonment_years.reason: The Court sentenced the five accused to 7 years imprisonment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary is accurate, neutral, and stops before court proceedings without naming parties or revealing outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment range.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim was killed, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death from multiple injuries including stab wounds, with simple injuries from sticks, matches the judgment.

number_of_offences.reason: Six sections were charged (143, 147, 148, 341, 323, 302/149); one new conviction under s.326/149.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or financial loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court rejected planned murder but found the assembly searched for rival workers in buses.

motive.reason: Political rivalry between the opposing parties is accepted by the Court.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: PW3, PW4, post-mortem findings, and the identified knife are relied upon as stated.

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW3 independent and believed by both courts; PW4 believed by Trial Court; PW5 believed by Trial Court but disbelieved by High Court; PW6 disbelieved by both courts
witness_credibility.quote: According to the Trial Court there was no material contradiction brought out in the evidence of PW5 Balan who was an eyewitness.
witness_credibility.reason: Trial Court believed PW5; value wrongly says lower courts disbelieved him.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is described.

trial_duration.reason: Offence, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel for accused, complainant, and State match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.reason: FIR No. 95 of 1993 and private complaint after perfunctory investigation are stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Supreme Court noted no irregularity; High Court rejected the FIR delay objection.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted seven (A1-A4, A14, A15, A18) under s.302/149 (life), acquitted others. High Court: A3, A14, A15, A18 acquitted of s.302/149; A2 and A4 convicted under s.324/149 (1 year). Supreme Court: A3, A4, A14, A15, A18 convicted under s.326/149 (7 years); other acquittals upheld
appeal_history.quote: Al toA4,Al4,AlS andA18 were convicted under Section 302/149 IPC and sentenced to imprisonment for life.
appeal_history.reason: Trial court convicted seven, not six; High Court change for A2 is omitted.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the complainant and State arguments on PW4, PW5, common object, and s.302/149.

defence_argument.correct_value: PW4, PW5 and PW6 were interested partisan witnesses; no independent eyewitness; conduct unnatural; benefit of doubt due; mere presence without overt act not inculpatory (A4)
defence_argument.quote: submitted that they are all interested witnesses who deposed at the instance of the complainant
defence_argument.reason: Defence named PW4, PW5 and PW6 as interested, not PW3.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Common object inference, vicarious liability by presence, and dissociation test are applied as stated.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Lalji, Dan Singh, and Shivaji Sahabrao Bobade are relied on with matching citations.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court cites 1993 incident and simple injuries by sticks to justify s.326/149 sentence.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Time lapse since 1993 and simple non-vital injuries are weighed by the Court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Court does not expressly weigh aggravating factors for sentencing.

other_sentence_order.reason: Direction to A3, A4, A14, A15, A18 to surrender within 4 weeks is stated.
